title: Descent of the ordinary scalar comparison with its counit square
statement: Fix l, E, T, a clopen U and d [def-sf-clopen-restriction-data]. For an exponent n+1, assume only a natural isomorphism c between the two ordinary scalar-extension and restriction composites [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. There is a natural isomorphism of the derived composites whose equation with the canonical universal counits holds for every complex P, and whose chain comparison is NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex c [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. No K-flat hypothesis on P is imposed.

source.place: Tag 06YY, derived base change and pullback K-flat resolution descent.

proof.text: Partition T into U and its open complement, including empty components. Apply finite-clopen K-flat detection to the raw restriction. Transport the result along the lifted completion-ring isomorphism to show the actual completed restriction preserves K-flat complexes.

Assemble the universal scalar counits into natural transformations on complexes. They are isomorphisms on K-flat complexes. Apply the existing generic descendComparison using K-flat resolutions and the preservation just proved to obtain the derived comparison with its counit equation on K-flat representatives.

For arbitrary P choose a K-flat resolution K to P. Express the two sides of the desired square as natural transformations, precompose with the resolution image, use their naturality and the equation at K, and cancel the inverted resolution. This yields exactly the square at P.

theorem sf_clopen_scalar_comparison_descent
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : Scheme.{t}) (U : T.Opens)
    (hU : IsClosed (U : Set T)) (d : SfClopenCoefficientRestriction l E T U) (n : ℕ)
    (c : scalarReductionExtension l E T n ⋙
        sfClopenModuleRestriction U _ _ (d.finite n) ≅
      sfClopenModuleRestriction U (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E T)
        (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l E U.toScheme) d.completion ⋙
        scalarReductionExtension l E U.toScheme n) :
    letI := scalarReductionExtensionAdditive l E T n
    letI := scalarReductionExtensionAdditive l E U.toScheme n
    letI := d.additive
    letI := d.finite_additive n
    ∃ reduction : scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E T n ⋙
        sfClopenFiniteDerivedRestriction d n ≅
      sfClopenDerivedRestriction d ⋙ scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E U.toScheme n,
      ∀ P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E T) ℤ,
      (sfClopenFiniteDerivedRestriction d n).map (sfClopenReductionCounit T n P) ≫
          (sfClopenFiniteLocalizationIso d n
            (unrestrictedTowerFiniteComplex l E T n P)).hom ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex c (.up ℤ)).app P).hom =
        reduction.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
          (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E U.toScheme n).map
            (sfClopenLocalizationIso d P).hom ≫
          sfClopenReductionCounit U.toScheme n ((sfClopenComplexRestriction d).obj P)
